subject: MAP: security escape-hatch, SIG/CAIQ responses, DPA redline and retention sprint
messages:
From: Elena Marquez <elena.marquez@bridgefin.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-01-10T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Questions on MAP: retention window & escape-hatch

Hi Sean and Naomi,

Thanks for sending over the mutual action plan draft. We reviewed the sections related to data retention and an 'escape-hatch' if the Private deployment cannot meet our residency requirements. A few quick clarifications we need before we sign off on timeline: 

- Can you confirm the maximum retention for application logs and backups (audit, logs, backups each separated)?
- What exactly does the escape-hatch look like operationally? Is there a defined fallthrough to hosted with encryption in transit+rest and a region lock?
- We also need the SIG/CAIQ responses tightened to our procurement template and a copy of your most recent SOC 2 Type II.

I attached a short PDF with comments (BridgeFin_MAP_Questions.pdf). Our procurement team is on standby; copying procurement for visibility.

Best,
Elena Marquez
Senior Security Manager
BridgeFin

Attachment: BridgeFin_MAP_Questions.pdf (pdf stub)

From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
To: Elena Marquez <elena.marquez@bridgefin.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-01-11T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Questions on MAP: retention window & escape-hatch

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear notes and the PDF.

Quick answers and next steps:

- Retention proposal (we can make fields configurable in the MAP):
  - Application/transaction logs: 180 days (configurable to 90 days with SLA caveats)
  - Audit logs (immutable): 7 years (we propose export/escrow if you prefer shorter live retention)
  - Backups: 3 year rolling snapshots by default, with archive option up to 7 years on request

- Escape-hatch design: if Private deployment cannot satisfy region lock or required KMS controls we will fall back to a dedicated hosted instance scoped to BridgeFin account in us-west-2 with customer-managed KMS, network allowlist, and per-route isolation. There will be a 14-day transition window and a documented rollback/playbook. This fallback keeps encrypted-at-rest keys isolated to your key alias.

- SIG/CAIQ and SOC 2: Naomi will share the SOC2 link and we will produce a SIG/CAIQ spreadsheet tailored to your procurement template.

I've attached an updated MAP draft with the above proposed retention tiers and an escape-hatch description (redwood-proposed-map-v1.pdf). Can you confirm whether 180 days for logs is acceptable or if procurement needs 90? Also confirm whether BridgeFin requires escrow for audit logs.

If you approve, Karthik and I will fold this into the deal timeline for DF-8421 and aim to get a sign-off by next week.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-proposed-map-v1.pdf (pdf stub)

Sean —

Thanks, this is helpful. Procurement prefers 90 days for application logs out of the box and wants the 7-year audit backup to be optional via escrow.

Two asks before we proceed:
- Can you send the SOC 2 Type II (link or the report) and the SIG/CAIQ spreadsheet filled against BridgeFin template?
- Please upload the DPA redline into DocuSign so legal can review signatures/timestamped edits.

If those are available by EOD Wednesday we can keep the sign-off target for next week.

Best,
Elena

Hi Elena,

Appreciate the fast turn. Attaching the resources and calling out specifics inline so procurement/legal have what they need.

Provided materials (attached + links):
- SOC2 Type II (SOC2_Type2_Report_2028.pdf) — full report link: https://drive.redwood.com/reports/SOC2-2028
- SIG/CAIQ responses spreadsheet tailored to BridgeFin template: https://docs.redwood.com/sig-caiq/bridgefin-responses.xlsx
- DPA redline (DocuSign): https://app.docusign.com/dfs/12345-redwood-dpa-redline

Retention clarifications (per Sean's draft, options):
- Application/transaction logs: default 180 days; procurement option: 90 days. Shorter window requires a retention SLA note in the MAP and optional export to BridgeFin-managed S3 (90-day export cadence).
- Audit logs (immutable): by default retained 7 years; alternative: escrow export every 30 days to customer-controlled storage for a 1 year live retention and 7 year archive in escrow.
- Backups: 3 year rolling snapshots; archive to cold storage up to 7 years on request (we can pre-configure archive lifecycle).

Escape-hatch operational detail:
- Trigger conditions: failure to meet region-specific KMS or residency controls within 30 days of final deployment test, or unmitigated critical SOC2 gap discovered during final acceptance.
- Execution: Redwood runs an automated full export of production data under customer encryption keys, provisions a dedicated hosted environment with customer-managed KMS in us-west-2, and performs a switchover with a tested rollback plan. Estimated SLA impact window: 8-24 hours for small deployments, up to 3 business days for larger deployments depending on dataset size.

Attachments: SOC2_Type2_Report_2028.pdf (pdf stub), SIG_CAIQ_BridgeFin_Responses.xlsx (xlsx stub)

Let me know if procurement wants the export cadence built into the MAP definitions (we can add a checkbox in the final doc).

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Head of Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference

Attachment: SOC2_Type2_Report_2028.pdf (pdf stub)
